segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: AI data-center platforms (Blackwell Ultra ramp); up 117% YoY and 93% of total revenue. Within it, Hyperscale was $48,710M (+102% YoY) and AI Clouds, Industrial & Enterprise was $40,313M (+138% YoY).

segments.name: Edge Computing
segments.note: PC, workstation, robotics and automotive platforms; up 27% YoY, driven by strong Blackwell workstation sales partly offset by slower consumer PC sales.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: R&D spending on new chips and platforms like Vera Rubin; up 64% YoY as Nvidia hires and builds faster.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Sales and admin costs; up 21% YoY, growing far slower than revenue.

oneTimers: Net gains from equity securities of $7,771M lifted GAAP other income (excluded from non-GAAP results) — the main reason GAAP net income of $59,688M exceeds non-GAAP net income of $53,954M.

sources.label: CFO commentary, incl. revenue by market platform (SEC EDGAR)

verdict: Nvidia's revenue more than doubled to $96.2B on the Blackwell Ultra ramp — data centers are now 93% of the business — but $7.8B of the $59.7B profit came from gains on its stock portfolio, not from selling chips.
otherDetail: Other income of $7,773M, almost entirely a $7,771M net gain on equity securities (excluded from non-GAAP results).
footerNote: Revenue by market platform, as reported in Nvidia's CFO commentary: Data Center and Edge Computing.
follow100Note: Data Center takes $92.52 of every $100 — and $8.08 more comes back from gains on Nvidia's stock holdings. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Data Center is the whole story
takeaways.text: Data Center revenue hit $89.0B, up 117% — 93% of all revenue. Hyperscalers alone bought $48.7B of AI platforms, and AI clouds, industrial and enterprise customers another $40.3B.

takeaways.title: A big chunk of profit isn't from chips
takeaways.text: Net gains on equity securities added $7,771M to other income. GAAP net income of $59.7B beats non-GAAP's $54.0B almost entirely because of those paper gains.

takeaways.title: Next quarter is already guided higher
takeaways.text: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 revenue to ~$108B (±2%) at a 74% gross margin — and assumes zero data-center revenue from China in the outlook.
